definitions.explanation: Describes someone who approaches tasks or activities with great energy and dedication. Typically used for sustained effort over time rather than momentary bursts of energy.

examples.japanese: {精力的|せいりょくてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{精力的|せいりょくてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。

⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{七十歳|ななじっさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎて→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{精力的|せいりょくてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{海外出張|かいがいしゅっちょう}→海外出張：24173_kaigaishucchou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こなしている→こなす：09897_konasu⟧。
examples.english: The president continues to handle overseas business trips energetically even past seventy.

notes:
A positive word describing sustained, purposeful energy. Most commonly used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ as an adverb modifying verbs of action. It conveys admiration for someone's tireless effort and is frequently used in biographical and news writing.

FORMS:
⟦{精力|せいりょく}→精力：05526_seiryoku⟧ (energy, vitality) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (-like, -ful)

- {精力的|せいりょくてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be actively engaged
- {精力的|せいりょくてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧: to tackle something vigorously
- {精力的|せいりょくてき}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: an energetic person
- {精力的|せいりょくてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work energetically

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{活発|かっぱつ}→活発：13272_kappatsu⟧: active, lively — more general; can describe children, discussions, or markets
- ⟦{積極的|せっきょくてき}→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧: proactive, positive — emphasizes willingness and initiative rather than raw energy
